subject: Planned: Phased node-drain & device-driver compatibility window (US-west regions)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Acme Retail Support <acme-retail-support@acmecorp.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Planned: Phased node-drain & device-driver compatibility window (US-west regions)

Hi Sanjay —

We have a scheduled maintenance window next week that will apply to our US-west inference clusters and I wanted to share the plan early so your SREs and on-call can plan for it. This is a compatibility-focused maintenance: a microcode/driver update to improve NVLink stability and a targeted kernel driver compatibility patch.

High level:
- Window: 2026-11-08 00:00 — 2026-11-09 08:00 PT (8-hour rolling window per AZ; total span ~32 hours to minimize customer impact)
- Affected regions: us-west1 (primary) and us-west2 (staggered).
- Risk: short-lived p99 latency spikes (10–30s) during node restarts for in-flight streaming requests; rare single-request 503 on drained nodes while autoscaling/route rebalancing occurs.
- Mitigations: phased node drain (no all-at-once restarts), warm-up replays of KV cache, automatic fallback to sibling AZs and pre-warmed burst capacity.

What to expect for Acme Retail:
- No action required for typical traffic; if you have pinned instances or strict affinity please let us know so we can exclude those during the window.
- We recommend pausing any long-running batch jobs that depend on strict tail-latency guarantees during the specific AZ windows.
- If you want a blackout (no changes) for a particular 2‑hour block, reply with preferred times and we will attempt to schedule around it.

Attachments: runbook-v2.pdf (detailed steps), maintenance-checklist.xlsx (pre/post validation).

I'll follow up with a short runbook and an on-call contact list. If you'd rather we route this through your procurement or platform team, loop them in and we'll coordinate.

Thanks,
Karthik

Subject: Re: Planned: Phased node-drain & device-driver compatibility window (US-west regions) — internal runbook & exclusions

Team —

Acme asked to exclude pool id acme-checkout-01 and wants AZ-by-AZ schedule. Action items:
- Priyom: update runbook-v2.pdf with exclusion step and add conftest warnings for pinned pools (owner: priyom).
- Monica: coordinate with Ops to ensure the pre-warm replay is executed for us-west1/us-west2 before each AZ drain; confirm warm-up size and expected KV cache hit ramp.
- Jonas: can you prepare a 2-hour blackout option for Acme and provide the exact AZ sequence (west1a -> west1b -> west2a -> west2b) and estimated start times? They need 48 hours notice for batch jobs.

We will include the post-maintenance checklist as part of the ticket and offer to run an end-to-end smoke test with Acme after the last AZ completes. I'll draft a short postmortem template (postmortem-draft.md) to use if we observe any SLA impact.

Runbook & checklist are attached for reference. Keep replies threaded under this subject.

Karthik
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Acme Retail Support <acme-retail-support@acmecorp.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Post-maintenance: US-west compatibility window complete — summary & next steps

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for the collaboration. The maintenance window completed this morning for the last AZ. Summary:
- Timeline followed (west1a -> west1b -> west2a -> west2b). Total elapsed coordination span ~30 hours.
- Observed impact: three brief p99 spikes (max 18s) during active drains; two 503s correlated with a single autoscale handoff for a draining host. No sustained errors and no data loss.
- Actions taken: immediate rollback was not required; traffic rerouted automatically and we performed targeted KV cache replays. Post-checklist validation passed (see attachment).

Next steps for Acme Retail:
- We excluded acme-checkout-01 per your request. If you want the post-maintenance smoke test, reply with a 1-hour window and Monica will schedule.
- We are preparing a short postmortem (draft attached). If you prefer a joint review call, suggest a time and we'll invite the runbook owners and on-call engineers.
- Per our SLA, if you observed measurable availability drop beyond the metrics in the checklist, we'll evaluate a credit. Please send any incidents you recorded.

Attachments: postmortem-draft.md (draft), maintenance-checklist.xlsx (results).

Appreciate the coordination — we aim to tighten the warm-up sequence in the next rollout to reduce the transient spikes.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Program Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
